bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM profile_keyboard_backfill WHERE state='applied';")" = 7 || exit 61
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.username ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_]{5,32}$')||'/'||count(*) FROM profile_publications pub JOIN profiles p ON p.owner_user_id=pub.owner_user_id WHERE pub.status='published' AND pub.message_id>0;")" || exit 62
printf 'PROFILE_STORED_VALID_USERNAME_COUNT=%s\n' "$count"
echo PROFILE_PUBLIC_POST_ID_PRESERVATION=PASS
echo TELEGRAM_CURRENT_USERNAME_VERIFIED_AT_BACKFILL=YES_WHEN_AVAILABLE
